method.angularEdge: mean absolute intensity difference across +/-0.12 degree around each sector boundary, sampled through the ring interior
method.radialEdge: mean absolute intensity difference across +/-1.5 px around each radial boundary, sampled within +/-2 degrees of sector center
method.normalization: percentile rank per evidence channel across all 288 conditional fields
method.score: geometric mean of left/right/inner/outer evidence percentiles
method.screeningRule: SUPPORTED_SCREENING if score>=0.65 and minimum channel percentile>=0.35; PARTIAL_SCREENING if score>=0.45 and minimum>=0.15; otherwise UNRESOLVED_SCREENING
method.warning: Heuristic screening only. It does not promote MF to AK and does not establish final field cardinality.

interpretation.R01: No field passes the strong screening rule; consistent with the previously identified ambiguity of the ~0.50R boundary.
interpretation.R03: Strongest candidate band in this pass; 26/72 pass strong screening.
interpretation.R04: Second strongest candidate band; 24/72 pass strong screening.
interpretation.conclusion: The evidence does not support treating all 288 conditional addresses as equally structural. Per-field cross-source confirmation and topology freeze remain required.

next.stage: MF-288 cross-source refinement + central rose segmentation
next.rule: Do not assign AK IDs from screening classes.
